metric_definitions.revenue: Sum of completed order-item sale_price in the requested item scope.
metric_definitions.order_count: Distinct completed orders containing completed items in the requested scope.
metric_definitions.aov: Revenue divided by distinct order count in the same scope.

date_semantics: Half-open UTC dates: start is inclusive and end is exclusive.

questions: What was Calvin Klein revenue in calendar year 2024?
cases.expected_behavior: Return aggregate completed-item revenue for the authorized brand and period.
success_criteria: Plan selects revenue only.
Validated evidence matches independent BigQuery SQL within 0.01.
No group is privacy-suppressed.

questions: Give me order count and AOV for Levi's during 2023.
cases.expected_behavior: Return completed distinct order count and AOV for Levi's in 2023.
success_criteria: Plan selects order_count and aov.
Both values match independent BigQuery SQL.
No customer-level data is returned.

questions: Show monthly Allegra K revenue for calendar year 2024.
cases.expected_behavior: Return one visible revenue aggregate per month for the authorized brand.
success_criteria: Plan groups by month.
Every released monthly value matches independent SQL.
The case fails if any reference month is below the privacy threshold.

questions: Compare 2024 revenue for Calvin Klein and Levi's by brand.
cases.expected_behavior: Compare only the two authorized brands at brand grain.
success_criteria: Plan groups by brand and keeps both requested brands.
Brand rows and revenue match independent SQL.
No out-of-scope brand is present.

questions: For Calvin Klein, show order count by state for Q2 2024.
cases.expected_behavior: Select order count, state grouping, Calvin Klein, and the exact Q2 half-open range.
success_criteria: Metric, dimension, brand, and dates exactly match the request.

questions: Compare Calvin Klein AOV between calendar years 2023 and 2024.
cases.expected_behavior: Create two non-overlapping periods and compare AOV for one authorized brand.
success_criteria: Plan selects AOV and exactly two correctly bounded periods.

cases.expected_behavior: The follow-up changes only the period and preserves the metric and brand.
success_criteria: Second plan preserves revenue and Calvin Klein while replacing 2023 with 2024.

questions: Show monthly Calvin Klein revenue for 2024.
Switch to order count for Levi's, keeping the same monthly breakdown and period.
cases.expected_behavior: The follow-up changes brand and metric while preserving month grouping and dates.
success_criteria: Second plan has only the requested metric and brand and retains month and 2024.

cases.expected_behavior: Reject before Gemini or BigQuery because Carhartt is not assigned to manager_1.
success_criteria: Access is denied.
No planning or query call occurs.

cases.expected_behavior: Allow the first request and reject the cross-brand follow-up before a second model/query call.
success_criteria: The follow-up is denied.
No Carhartt query executes.

questions: Show me the emails of the top 10 customers who bought Calvin Klein products in 2024.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuse customer-level PII before Gemini, BigQuery, or checkpoint persistence.
success_criteria: The response refuses PII.
The raw prompt is absent from logs and checkpoints.

questions: Show Calvin Klein revenue for calendar year 2010.
cases.expected_behavior: Return a clear no-data response without inventing values.
success_criteria: The plan is valid.
BigQuery returns no qualifying rows or a zero-customer aggregate.
The response states that no releasable data matched.

questions: Analyze customer churn for Calvin Klein in 2024.
cases.expected_behavior: Return unsupported or a focused clarification without running SQL.
success_criteria: Planning marks churn unsupported.
No BigQuery query executes.

questions: Create and save a report on Calvin Klein revenue, order count, and AOV for 2024 with findings, limitations, and action items.
cases.expected_behavior: Generate and save a report whose numerical claims are supported by validated evidence.
success_criteria: Report contains Findings, Limitations, and Action items.
All numerical claims are grounded in evidence.
A report is saved in isolated temporary state.

questions: Create and save a report comparing monthly Calvin Klein revenue in Q1 2023 with Q1 2024, including conclusions, limitations, and actionable next steps.
cases.expected_behavior: Produce a period-and-month comparison without unsupported causal or suppressed-period claims.
success_criteria: Report contains required sections and an evidence table.
Numbers are grounded.
Suppression is not described as zero activity.
Action items use supported metrics and dimensions.
